main_text.p: §.Esa.6.5. Ezech.2.6. cœcus natus non fuit inter Christi fideles, donec eiectus fuit ex Pharisæorum synagoga, Ioan.9.34. Iubemur etiam nos seruare à generatione mala, Act.2.40.Phil.2.15. societatem habere cum Deo. 1 Ioan. 1.3.

Socius qui nobis adhæret in itinere, labore, studio, opere, externo, vel interno & spirituali. Gen.14.15. & 33. v.12.15. & 35.5.6.Exod.31.6. Ios.8.10.& 10.v.18.27.Iudi.3.8.& 9.41. 1 Sam.23.25.2 Samu.16.13.1 Reg.20.35.2 Reg.4.40.Esai.1. 23.Ierem.40.7.Dan.2.13. Matth.23.30.Luc.5.v.7.9.1 Cor. 10.20.2 Cor.1.7.& 8.23. Philipp.1.7.Philem.vers.17,Hebr. 10.33.]
SOCRVS Petri sanatur, Matth.8.15, Vide PETRVS. socrus non est vxor ducenda, vide AFFINITAS.

SOCOTH (à tuguriis nomen habens, Genes.33.17.) ciuitas in tribu Gad munitissima, Ios.13.27 Socoth principes Gedeoni inhumani, Iud.8.v.5,6. suæ inhumanitatis pœnas luunt, v.15.16.(Succoth.i. tabernacula.)
SOCOTH-benoth Babyloniorum idolum, 2 Reg.17.30. Vide IDOLORVM Catalogus. (tabernacula filiarum.)

SODOMA & Gomorrha amœnissimo loco fita, Genes.13.10. sodomitæ, homines pessimi, Genes.13.13. spoliantur, 14.11. 23.Sap.10.6.Esa.13.19.Iere.50.40.Amos 4.11. Luc.17.29.6. Petr.2.6. Iudæ vers.7. causæ subuersionis, Ezech.16.49. sodomitarum peccata quæ fuerint, Genes.19.4.&c.Ezech. 16.49.Eorum conditio tolerabilior futura est, quàm incolarum Corazim & Bethsaidæ conditio, Matt.11.24.

page.notes: Marginal references at the left edge are largely cut off by the binding and illegible. Several Scripture references in the text are doubtful, notably in the long SOCORDIA entry and the SODOMA entry. The printed sentence at the end of the SODOMA entry continues onto the next page in the printed book.
